description: This file handles the merging and duplicate processing for records in a CRM system, including saving merged data, transferring related records, and rendering merge interfaces.

classes.name: vtigerCRM_Smarty
classes.description: Custom Smarty class used for rendering templates within the CRM system.

methods.name: transferRelatedRecords
methods.description: Transfers related records from multiple source records to a target record after merging.

methods.name: DeleteEntity
methods.description: Deletes a record from the system based on module and record id.

methods.name: getParentTab
methods.description: Retrieves the parent tab number or identifier in the CRM interface.

methods.name: isPermitted
methods.description: Checks if the current user has permissions for certain actions on a module and record.

methods.name: getRecordValues
methods.description: Retrieves values from multiple records for display or merging.
